description: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:553-558 — lints() returns a reference to a lazily-initialized static Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> via OnceLock. But lint_runner() calls all_lints() afresh, bypassing the cache and allocating a new set of Box<dyn Lint> objects on every call. The cache exists precisely to avoid this. Fix: document why they are separate, or have lint_runner() be the only allocation point and remove the OnceLock, or have lints() return a non-static slice from all_lints() without caching.
title: CabfTlsBrProfile::lint_runner() ignores the OnceLock lints() cache and calls all_lints() fresh
